title: FY 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP (AARO/ODNI joint)
doc_notes: This is the FY 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena produced by the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO).

incidents.summary: Commercial pilot reported white flashing lights in the night sky, later correlated to a Starlink satellite launch.
incidents.quote: a commercial pilot reported white flashing lights in the night sky

incidents.summary: Commercial aircrew reported a near miss with a cylindrical object over the Atlantic Ocean.
incidents.location_name: Atlantic Ocean off the coast of New York
incidents.quote: a commercial aircrew reported a near miss with a cylindrical object

incidents.summary: Crashed UAS recovered at D.C. Cook Nuclear Power Plant.
incidents.location_name: D.C. Cook Nuclear Power Plant, Michigan
incidents.quote: security recovered a crashed UAS that was given to Berrien County, Michigan, local law enforcement

incidents.summary: UAS flyovers observed for six consecutive nights at a fuel cycle facility.
incidents.quote: observed UAS flyovers for six consecutive nights
